controls.setting: Protect main with review and status checks before normal merge.
controls.reason: Main is the GitHub source of truth and should stay rollback-ready.
controls.externalEvidence: Verify branch protection in GitHub before claiming active protection.

controls.setting: Require npm run check:seis-master-prompt-report and npm run check:seis-master-prompt for governance changes.
controls.reason: Master Prompt changes must stay tied to generated evidence and a dedicated quality gate.
controls.externalEvidence: Verify current GitHub check runs before claiming green readiness.

controls.setting: CODEOWNERS review covers governance, plugin, workflow, report, and SSH hardening surfaces.
controls.reason: Operating-contract changes need explicit maintainer review.
controls.externalEvidence: Verify CODEOWNERS review requirement in GitHub branch settings before claiming enforcement.

controls.setting: Do not claim pushed, merged, deployed, connected, ready, or protected without current command or GitHub evidence.
controls.reason: SEIS readiness claims must match actual observed state.
controls.externalEvidence: Verify deployment, SSH, GitHub, or check-run state before readiness claims.
